name: Emoji Sorter
description: Find emojis faster in the emoji and reaction pickers: servers whose emojis you use most or that you open most first, servers sorted A to Z, by most emojis or most animated, the server you're in kept first, chosen servers hidden, and Discord's default emoji moved above your servers or hidden.
author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")
